copy.description_500c: Astra Destiny is a free, privacy-first Vedic astrology suite powered by 294 Jyotish calculation algorithms running entirely in the browser. It calculates full Kundli birth charts, D1–D60 divisional charts, 18 dasha systems (including Vimshottari, Kalachakra, and Narayana), Ashtakoota compatibility (Gun Milan), Panchang, Choghadiya, and automated Yoga and Dosha detection. Calculations use NASA JPL DE-series ephemeris with Lahiri Ayanamsa, with zero server-side storage of personal birth data.
key_features: 294 Jyotish calculation engines running 100% client-side in the browser
NASA JPL DE-series ephemeris with high-precision Lahiri Ayanamsa
Full Kundli birth chart, Sripati Bhava Chalit, and D1–D60 divisional charts
18 Dasha systems including Vimshottari, Ashtottari, Yogini, and Narayana
Ashtakoota 36-Guna matching with Mangal Dosha detection
Daily real-time Panchang, Tithi, Nakshatra, and Choghadiya calculations
Strict privacy: zero server data collection or birth information tracking

taxonomy.free_tier_details: 100% free with unlimited calculations. No paywalls, no mandatory registration.
